summary: Shows how to view the decrypted value of an encrypted variable with the debug module, loading the vars file with -e @vars.yml and supplying the vault ID.
questions: How do I see the plaintext value of a vault-encrypted variable?
How do I check what an encrypted variable decrypts to?

answer_card.title: View an encrypted variable's value
answer_card.answer_md:
Use the `debug` module with the same password used to encrypt it:

```console
ansible localhost -m ansible.builtin.debug -a var="new_user_password" -e "@vars.yml" --vault-id dev@a_password_file

localhost | SUCCESS => {
    "new_user_password": "hunter2"
}
```
